name: BigAir
summary: Enterprise fixed-wireless network provider; acquired Unistar/Star-Tech (2010), AccessPlus (2011), Clever (2011), Allegro (2012), Link Innovations (2012), Intelligent IP (2013), Anittel (2014), Everywhere Internet (2015), IDL (2015); acquired by Superloop (BIGAIR COMMUNITY BROADBAND PTY LTD, ACN 084 163 100).

events.details: Acquired by Superloop via scheme of arrangement; suspended 9 Dec 2016, delisted from ASX 21 Dec 2016.

refs.label: deListed Australia: BigAir Group Limited (ASX:BGL) — delisted 21 Dec 2016 (Superloop scheme of arrangement)

events.details: ASX-listed parent was BIGAIR GROUP LIMITED (ASX:BGL), listed 7 Apr 2006. Cited ACN 084 163 100 (BIGAIR COMMUNITY BROADBAND PTY LTD, reg. 1 Nov 1999) is a group subsidiary that carried the AccessPlus trading name, not the listed parent.
